bugs_found: compound_interest converts principal to float and then multiplies by Decimal, causing TypeError and precision loss
compound_interest silently truncates fractional years and does not validate negative principal
transfer does not normalize amount to Decimal, so float/string inputs can raise TypeError with Decimal balances
